title: Licensing and Price Competition in Tied-Goods Markets: An Application to the Single-Serve Coffee System Industry
authors: Pradeep K. Chintagunta; Marco Shaojun Qin; Maria Ana Vitorino
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Structural demand and dynamic supply model for single-serve coffee systems (tied goods) used to simulate licensing counterfactuals; package ships simulated data.
design_notes: Code&Data/simulation_estimation.m simulates data and estimates via GMM (gmmObj_simulatedData.m); supply-side and counterfactual routines. No reduced-form treatment regression.
data_provenance_note: readme: 'Main file that simulates data and does the estimation'.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
